description: Give every tile its time, in posting order (last tile first) spaced by the set's spacing. Approved tiles are scheduled at once and queued; drafts keep the time until a person approves them. Pass scheduled_at for the first tile, or leave it out for its next free slot. A tile waits for its time and for every tile posted before it to be out (the row below it, then the tiles to its right; the scheduler holds it), so a failed tile stops the set there. Tiles already posted are left alone. The grid crop figure is unmeasured, so this stays off until the owner measures it with a test post on a real profile.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

scheduled_at.description: When it goes out once approved. ISO 8601: with an offset it is that moment; without one (2026-11-02T09:00) it is that clock time in the post's time zone.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
